name: Resurf
tagline: A Personal Context Library for Mac
description: Resurf is a personal context app for things you like, care about, and work on. Save notes, links, images, PDFs, and ideas. Find them later or hand that context to AI through MCP and CLI. Native on Mac, iPhone, and iPad, with local storage and private iCloud sync.

name: Perplexity Hybrid Compute
tagline: Splitting AI tasks: Cloud for research, Mac for privacy
description: Hybrid Compute is now live on Perplexity Computer, their Mac app. It splits a task between the cloud and your own Mac: research and reasoning happen in the cloud with their strongest AI, while anything touching your private files stays on your Mac with a local AI, so it never gets uploaded. Works on Apple silicon, 24GB RAM minimum, live now for Pro/Max/Enterprise.

name: ScreenCursor
tagline: Screen recorder with auto zoom effects
description: Record your screen and get back a finished video with the camera moves already in place. Every click, drag and keystroke becomes a zoom. No editing, and nothing ever leaves your computer.

name: Cognition's SWE-2
tagline: Cognition's coding model, 64% cheaper than Fable 5.1
description: SWE-2 is Cognition's new coding model, post-trained from Kimi K3 with RL that optimizes for cost and capability at the same time. It hits 50.0% on FrontierCode 1.1 Main, within a point of Fable 5.1 at 64% less, and lands within a few points of GPT-6 Astra at a quarter of the cost. Compared to SWE-1.7 it takes 58% fewer turns and costs 81% less while scoring higher. Available now in Devin Desktop and CLI.

name: Visiby
tagline: Track and grow your visibility across AI search
description: Visiby helps brands measure, understand, and improve their visibility across AI search platforms like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews. Track brand mentions, recommendations, and citations, discover where competitors are winning, and identify opportunities to improve your presence in AI-generated answers.

name: Clipwise
tagline: Save any page to Notion
description: Clipwise saves any web page to your Notion databases — the whole article, not half of it. No account, no login, no paywall. Fill in your database properties before saving, and it remembers your last one. Everything stays on your computer.

name: GhostWriter by MyHandler
tagline: Two taps and it's already written
description: Every other AI writes what you tell it. Ghostwriter writes what you already know. Double-tap Left Ctrl in any text field, in any app, and the reply is there — drawn from the thread on screen, your calendar, your files and your past meetings, indexed in an encrypted vault on your PC. It won't double-book you, and it matches how you write to that person, down to the sign-off. Then it stops: it types into the box and never sends. Windows.

name: DemoTV
tagline: The audience-ranked TV channel for product demos
description: DemoTV is a 24/7 channel of product demos, ranked by the people watching. Submit a short demo for free. Viewers watch head-to-head Channel Battles and back the product they'd actually try, and an Elo-style audience score decides who sits on Channels 1-3. Businesses can buy clearly labelled airtime: money buys exposure, completed views and clicks, never the ranking.

name: SHIUI
tagline: Hinomaru Ink Web UI Kit in Japanese Hinomaru style
description: SHIUI — a flat ink UI kit in the spirit of Hinomaru Japanese posters. Paper, sumi, vermilion. Zero shadows.

name: Neopress
tagline: Build and grow your website by chatting with AI
description: Build and grow your website in one AI-powered loop. Neopress brings website creation, CMS, SEO, and analytics into a single workspace. Publish server-rendered, AI-readable pages that search engines and AI crawlers can access. Then ask AI to analyze your metrics, uncover insights, and turn them into improvements to your site and content. Build, publish, measure, learn, and improve, all through conversation.

name: Epilude Notetaker
tagline: 100% private meeting notes
description: Epilude records meetings on your Mac with no bot in the call, then writes the transcript, summary, and action items. Notes save as Markdown files you own.

name: Kirokune
tagline: Keep work incident notes on your iPhone, without an account
description: Keep work incident notes, recordings and photos in an iPhone timeline. No account needed. Unlimited records in one case are free; extra cases and PDF export are optional paid features. Includes a free incident-log template.

name: Naverny Borshchu
tagline: Find and rate best borshch on one map
description: A community map of Ukrainian borshch. 278 bowls across 31 cities, each scored on 7 criteria by people who actually ate them: meatiness, beetiness, thickness, saltiness, aftertaste, presentation, overall. 103 are already rated, the other 175 still have no score and whoever tastes one first stays on it as its discoverer. Free, opensourced, no ads and no affiliate links

name: Best Productivity Resources
tagline: Directory of best tools, apps, guides, and other resources
description: A hand-curated directory of productivity tools, apps, AI tools, courses, books, and resources. Every listing links directly to the real product website and is reviewed before inclusion. Use it to find vetted options for task management, focus, note-taking, automation, and more

name: TablePro
tagline: Native database client, free and open source
description: TablePro connects to 35 databases, from MySQL and Postgres to MongoDB, Redis and DuckDB. Written in AppKit and SwiftUI, no Electron, no JVM. Cold start under a second, 80 MB idle. Editor, grid, import and export are free. AGPL v3.

name: Cue
tagline: The Awwwards-tier UI component library.
description: Introducing CUE — the Awwwards-tier UI component library for the modern web. Explore a growing collection of beautifully crafted, interactive components designed to help you build websites that don’t just work — they stand out. From bold hero sections to smooth interactions, unique layouts, and thoughtful micro-animations, CUE brings high-end web design closer to your next project. Build less. Create more. Explore CUE → cuedesign.space

name: MonoDuty
tagline: On-call alerts that reach you by email, SMS, and phone
description: MonoDuty brings incident alerts, on-call schedules, uptime monitors, and cron heartbeats together for small engineering teams. Connect your tools through webhooks, route alerts to the right person, and escalate unanswered incidents with email, SMS, and voice calls. Keep the team informed with Slack, Discord, and Microsoft Teams updates. Start free; paid plans add SMS, voice, and escalation policies.

name: Gemini app for Windows
tagline: Alt + Space and Gemini is right there
description: The official Gemini desktop app for Windows 10 and 11. Summon Gemini instantly over active work with Alt + Space to draft text, run agentic tasks with Gemini Spark, and pull context directly across Gmail, Docs, and Google Drive.

name: Arazio
tagline: Convert any file without leaving Finder
description: Every converter makes you open it, import the file, pick a format and find the output. Arazio removes all four steps. Pick a file up in Finder, hold Shift, and a radial menu appears around your cursor showing only the formats that file can actually become. Release toward one and the converted file lands next to the original. 283 conversions, 43 formats, 14 tools. Everything runs on your Mac — the conversion engines contain no networking code at all, enforced by a test that fails the build.

name: MARVIS
tagline: Know your rights. Track what moves. Protect what’s yours.
description: MARVIS is Music Artist Rights Virtual Intelligence: a private operating system for publishing, PRO registrations, DSP policy, royalties, copyright, neighboring rights, sync, and AI-music rules.
